decisions.decision: PDog is the project status companion
decisions.details: Approved pearl-white robot dog, cyan anime LED eyes, floppy mechanical ears. Six poses show saved real state; clicking opens a read-only explanation. Preserve compact cards, both themes, keyboard access, and reduced motion.

Use compact colored edges and explicit state labels. Keep audit grade/date and activity age separate; quiet starts after seven idle days. Celebrate only newly observed successful tasks once with small nonblocking sparkles, no layout movement or refresh replay; honor reduced motion.

Measure natural card heights into short CSS grid row spans. Fill shorter columns, preserve sorted DOM and pinned priority, and recalculate on content or width changes without rerendering open details.
